description: Hints in a window of the application. One verb for now: the Enter that opens the link a hint pick has focused.

functions.name: sendEnter
functions.description: Sends a trusted Enter key press to the focused element of the window, a main window or a message window. A script click on a link skips Thunderbird's check for a link that lies about its address, and a real key press runs it. The key is fixed and the call takes no text.
